Settings

Display
Bodoni Moda OFL · optical size axis follows the size
Text
Jost OFL · labels and short copy
Moves
serif display, airy setting, tracked capitals
Mood
luxurious, poised, quiet, sharp
Case
Display in sentence case with one italic word; labels in capitals tracked +0.3 em at 11 to 12 px; no bold anywhere.
Numerals and features
font-optical-sizing: auto; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums proportional-nums

No. 12 · 1992No. 12 · 1992

With optical sizing on, the hairlines thin out at display size and thicken in captions; switching it off shows why it matters.
Signature
Air as the luxury: the display line sits low and left with half the screen empty above it, labels pinned to the corners in tracked Jost, and the opsz axis keeps hairlines sharp at 96 px.
Use when
Fashion, jewellery, hotels, fragrance, galleries; anywhere a few words and a lot of space are the point.
Turns into slop when
When used for a product that needs to explain itself (it hides the information), when gold gradients or shimmer join it, or when the tracking is added to lowercase text.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
